name: Pulumi
description: Pulumi's hosted server reads stacks and resources, searches the Pulumi registry and can ask Pulumi's assistant to write infrastructure code.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.ai.pulumi.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
